name: AvtoVAZ (LADA)
verdict: Wholly state-owned through FSUE NAMI, subordinate to Russia's Ministry of Industry and Trade (since May 2023); tier proposed in the originating pull request.
note: Title sponsor of HC Lada ('Титульный спонсор' on the club's partners page, 2026/27); the LADA wordmark is on both shoulders (and the helmet) of the 2026-27 home jersey. Also a KHL league partner (see deal khl-avtovaz).
